vulnerability.name: GHSA-82fw-gwwq-j7x9
vulnerability.description: Vitest Path Traversal / Arbitrary File Read via @vitest/mocker Redirect Mock

statements.impact_statement: Vitest and @vitest/mocker are isolated devDependencies utilized exclusively for automated test execution during local development and CI pipelines. They are completely excluded from production builds and compiled release archives.

vulnerability.name: GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99
vulnerability.description: esbuild development server cross-origin request handling vulnerability

statements.impact_statement: esbuild is an internal transitive bundler used solely by Vite/Vitest for unit test execution. The esbuild standalone development server is never run in production or bound to public network interfaces.

vulnerability.name: GHSA-p293-qw3h-jr36
vulnerability.description: Next.js Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution on windows-hosted servers

statements.impact_statement: First Issues is hosted and deployed exclusively on Linux containers and Vercel Edge compute environments. Windows filesystem path handling and Windows-specific execution paths do not exist in the production runtime.

vulnerability.name: GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4
vulnerability.description: Next.js Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in Image Optimization API when AVIF files are used

statements.impact_statement: The First Issues application does not expose or accept arbitrary user-uploaded AVIF image files to the Next.js image optimization endpoint. Image assets are strictly limited to verified static SVG icons and trusted remote GitHub avatar endpoints.
